sections.title: Protein Pints
sections.blurb: Ten scoopable, macro-friendly pints built on a scoop of whey and everyday Amul milk. Each one clears 25 g of protein per pint and runs on LITE ICE CREAM, so expect a re-spin or two.

sections.title: Protein Pints
sections.blurb: Tangy, creamy and protein-dense, built on Greek yogurt, Epigamia Turbo, high-protein paneer and Amul's protein range. Several need no cooking and almost no measuring.

sections.title: Desi Ice Creams
sections.blurb: Malai kulfi, aamras, filter coffee, paan, sitaphal. The flavours you queue for at Naturals or the kulfi-wala, made full-fat and proper with Amul cream and Milkmaid.

sections.title: Global Classics
sections.blurb: Vanilla bean, dark chocolate, butterscotch, cookie dough and the rest of the parlour menu. Rich ICE CREAM bases, most with a MIX-IN finish.

sections.title: Gelato
sections.blurb: More milk, less cream, a cornflour-thickened base cooked on the stove. Dense, silky and served a little warmer than ice cream. Eggless by default, each with an optional egg-yolk crema version.

sections.title: Sorbets, Bowls & Shakes
sections.blurb: Gola-stall kala khatta, aam panna, Nagpur santra and more dairy-free sorbets, plus a protein smoothie bowl and a nostalgic malt thickshake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein
recipes.subtitle: The gym-bag classic, now scoopable
recipes.intro: Chocolate whey and peanut butter already share a shelf in half the kitchens in India. Peanut butter powder adds roasted flavour and protein without extra fat, and salted peanuts finish it.

steps.text: Blend milk, peanut butter, PB powder, cocoa, sweetener, salt and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, adding the whey last, for 45–60 s until smooth.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the peanuts and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, with a thin drizzle of peanut butter if you like.

tips: Spoon the peanut butter onto the milk, not the vessel walls, or it sticks to the plastic and never blends in.
Whey brands vary in sweetness. Taste the blended base and add sweetener only if it needs it.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin with a splash of milk before serving.
swaps: No PB powder: use 2 tbsp peanut butter in total (adds about 70 kcal and 7 g fat).
Higher protein: swap 250 ml of the milk for one pack of Amul High Protein Milk (about +27 g protein).
Gluten-free: most plain chocolate wheys are, but check the label.
recipes.shop_note: PB powder: Alpino on Amazon or Blinkit. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Cookies & Cream Protein
recipes.subtitle: Vanilla protein, Oreo in every bite
recipes.intro: Skimmed milk made rich with two spoons of milk powder, so the vanilla tastes like ice cream, not a shaker bottle. Oreos go in at the end, broken by hand, for real chunks.

ingredients.item: skimmed milk, e.g. Amul Slim n Trim
skimmed milk powder, e.g. Amul Sagar

steps.text: Blend milk, milk powder, sweetener, vanilla and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s until no powder remains.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, drop in the broken Oreos and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, topped with one extra crushed Oreo.

tips: Break each Oreo into 6–8 pieces by hand. Fine crumbs dissolve during MIX-IN and turn the whole pint grey.
Milk powder is the cheap trick: it adds body and milky flavour to skimmed milk with almost no fat.
For a whiter pint, use unflavoured whey and 1 tsp vanilla; many vanilla wheys tint the base beige.
swaps: Use Hide & Seek, Bourbon or Dark Fantasy pieces instead of Oreo.
Chocolate: use chocolate whey and add 1 tbsp cocoa to the base.
Lighter: use 2 Oreos (saves about 55 kcal).
recipes.shop_note: Skimmed milk powder: Amul Sagar on Blinkit or BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Kesar Pista Protein Kulfi
recipes.subtitle: Matka kulfi flavour, no hours of stirring
recipes.intro: Real kulfi means boiling milk down for an hour. Here, Amul High Protein Milk and a little milk powder give dense, rabdi-like body in minutes, while saffron and elaichi bring the matka smell.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Milk (35 g protein)

ingredients.note: 2 tbsp of it for the saffron

ingredients.item: skimmed milk powder, e.g. Amul Sagar

steps.text: Warm 2 tbsp of the toned milk for 10 s, crush in the saffron and steep 10 min. Cool to room temperature.
Blend both milks, saffron milk, milk powder, cardamom, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and run MIX-IN.
Serve in small kulhads, topped with saffron strands and slivered pistachio.

tips: Unflavoured whey keeps the saffron in front. Vanilla whey works too; use less sweetener.
For a firmer, more kulfi-like bite, return the spun pint to the freezer for 15–20 min before scooping.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Malai kulfi: skip the saffron; add 1 tsp edible rose water and a pinch of nutmeg.
No Amul High Protein Milk: use 360 ml toned milk and 30 g whey in total (about 45 g protein).
Badam-pista: add 1 tbsp chopped almonds with the pistachios.
recipes.shop_note: Amul High Protein Milk: Blinkit, Zepto or shop.amul.com (often sells out). Kesar: Blinkit. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Cold Coffee Mocha Chip Protein
recipes.subtitle: Café cold coffee, frozen solid
recipes.intro: Strong Nescafé, milk and a hit of cocoa: everything that makes a café cold coffee good, set as a scoopable pint. Dark chocolate chips go in after the spin, so they stay crunchy.

ingredients.item: instant coffee, e.g. Nescafé Classic or Bru

steps.text: Dissolve the coffee in the hot water and let it cool completely, about 5 min. Never pour hot liquid into the Blast.
Blend milk, cooled coffee, cocoa, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chocolate chips and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, dusted with a little cocoa or instant coffee.

tips: Freezing mutes coffee, so the base should taste slightly too strong before it goes into the pint.
Chop a dark chocolate bar into thin shards; they melt on the tongue better than chips.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Decaf: use any decaf instant coffee for an evening pint.
Hazelnut mocha: add 1 tbsp hazelnut spread to the base and skip the cocoa.
Lighter: use skimmed milk instead of toned (saves about 70 kcal and 9 g fat).
recipes.shop_note: Morde dark chocolate chips: Amazon or BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Protein
recipes.subtitle: Overripe bananas, finally put to use
recipes.intro: That spotty banana nobody wants is exactly what this pint needs. It brings sweetness and body, jaggery and cinnamon add loaf-cake warmth, and toasted walnuts with an oats biscuit stand in for the crust.

ingredients.item: skimmed milk, e.g. Amul Slim n Trim

steps.text: Dry-toast the walnuts 3–4 min until fragrant; cool and chop. Break the banana into chunks.
Blend milk, banana, jaggery, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45–60 s until silky.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the walnuts and crushed biscuit, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a pinch of cinnamon on top.

tips: The browner the banana, the sweeter the pint. Yellow bananas taste starchy and flat once frozen.
Banana makes this one of the creamiest protein pints; it rarely needs more than one re-spin.
Freeze extra ripe bananas peeled and chopped; thaw 10 min and they blend just as well.
swaps: Swap the walnuts for pecans or toasted almonds.
Choco-banana: add 1 tbsp cocoa to the base and use chocolate whey.
Gluten-free: replace the biscuit with 2 tbsp toasted rolled oats (certified gluten-free if needed).
recipes.shop_note: Jaggery powder: 24 Mantra or Organic Tattva on Blinkit or BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Protein
recipes.subtitle: Strawberries meet digestive biscuit crumble
recipes.intro: Greek yogurt and a spoon of cream cheese give this pint a baked-cheesecake tang, while real strawberries turn it pink without colouring. Crushed digestives go in last as the base.

ingredients.item: cream cheese, e.g. D'lecta or Go

steps.text: Blend milk, strawberries, yogurt, cream cheese, lemon juice, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 60 s until smooth and pink.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the crushed biscuits and run MIX-IN.
Top with a sliced strawberry and a little extra crumble.

tips: Soften the cream cheese for 15 min at room temperature, or it leaves white flecks in the base.
Frozen strawberries are often tarter than fresh; taste the base and add sweetener if needed.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin; add fresh crumble, as the old pieces go soft.
swaps: Blueberry cheesecake: use frozen blueberries instead of strawberries.
Mango cheesecake: use 130 g Alphonso pulp in season.
No cream cheese: use 40 g more Greek yogurt for a lighter, tangier pint.
recipes.shop_note: Frozen strawberries: Pluckk, Delishh or RealFrost on Blinkit/Zepto. Cream cheese: D'lecta on BigBasket. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Thandai Protein
recipes.subtitle: Holi's favourite drink, set as a pint
recipes.intro: Fennel, black pepper, cardamom and rose make thandai the most aromatic glass of milk in India. Soft paneer blended into the base adds malai-like body and pushes the protein up.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, soft, crumbled

steps.text: Soak the almonds in hot water 15 min, then peel. Meanwhile, stir the thandai masala into the cold milk to infuse.
Blend spiced milk, almonds, paneer, rose water, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 60 s until no paneer grains remain.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Top with crushed dried rose petals and slivered almonds or pistachios, if you like.

tips: Infusing the masala in cold milk for 15 min gives a rounder spice flavour than blending it in dry.
Thandai masalas differ in pepper; start with 1 tbsp, taste the blended base and add more if needed.
Use soft, fresh paneer. Dry paneer stays grainy however long you blend it.
swaps: Homemade masala: grind 1 tbsp almonds, 1 tsp each fennel and melon seeds, ½ tsp poppy seeds, 6 peppercorns, 4 cardamom pods, 1 tsp rose petals.
Instead of paneer, use 60 g Greek yogurt for a tangier pint.
Kesar thandai: bloom 10 saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm milk, cool, and add with the rose water.
recipes.shop_note: Thandai masala: Badshah on Amazon or Blinkit. Edible rose water and dried petals: Blinkit, or Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Lotus Biscoff Protein
recipes.subtitle: Caramelised biscuit, blended and crunched
recipes.intro: Biscoff appears twice: a spoon of spread blended into the base, then more spread and crushed biscuits folded through at the end. Greek yogurt keeps it creamy, and its slight tang tames the caramel.

steps.text: Blend milk, yogurt, 1 tbsp Biscoff spread, cinnamon, sweetener and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45–60 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, drizzle in the loosened spread, add the crushed biscuits and run MIX-IN.
Serve with half a Biscoff biscuit tucked into each scoop.

tips: Warm the mix-in spread only until pourable, not hot; hot spread melts a channel through the ice cream.
For visible ribbons, drizzle the spread over each scoop instead of running it through MIX-IN.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin; the biscuit softens overnight, so add a few fresh pieces.
swaps: No Biscoff: crushed ginger or cinnamon biscuits give a similar spiced-caramel flavour.
Lighter: skip the mix-in spread and use 4 crushed biscuits (saves about 50 kcal).
Coffee Biscoff: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 1 tbsp hot water, cool, and add to the base.
recipes.shop_note: Lotus Biscoff spread and biscuits: Blinkit, Zepto or Amazon. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Rose Falooda Protein
recipes.subtitle: The Irani café falooda, in a pint
recipes.intro: Rooh Afza turns a plain whey base the exact pink of a Mumbai falooda and brings the rose with it. Sabja and tutti-frutti go in after the spin, so they stay soft and chewy.

mixins.item: sabja (sweet basil) seeds, soaked in 3 tbsp water
cooked falooda sev, chilled, cut short

steps.text: Soak the sabja in 3 tbsp water for 15 min, then chill. If using sev, cook as per the pack, rinse cold and chill.
Blend milk, Rooh Afza, rose water and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 45 s. Taste; add sweetener only if needed.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the drained sabja, tutti-frutti and sev, and run MIX-IN.
Serve in tall glasses with an extra drizzle of Rooh Afza.

tips: Drain the sabja well; extra water freezes into icy streaks.
Keep mix-ins to about ⅓ cup in total, or MIX-IN cannot fold them through evenly.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Falooda shake: add 120 ml (½ cup) cold milk to the spun pint and run MILKSHAKE.
Kesar falooda: replace Rooh Afza with 15 saffron strands bloomed in warm milk, cooled, plus 4 spoons Sugar Free Natura.
Swap the tutti-frutti for chopped pistachios for a less sweet, crunchier pint.
recipes.shop_note: Sabja and falooda sev: Blinkit or BigBasket (Weikfield falooda mix also works). Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Brownie Batter Protein
recipes.subtitle: Double chocolate with real brownie chunks
recipes.intro: Cocoa, chocolate syrup and chocolate whey make a base as dark as raw brownie batter, and a pinch of coffee deepens it. Amul High Protein Milk does most of the protein work, so you need little whey.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Milk (35 g protein)
instant coffee, e.g. Nescafé or Bru

mixins.item: brownie, in 1 cm cubes, frozen 15 min

steps.text: Blend both milks, cocoa, syrup, coffee, sweetener, salt and xanthan in the Ninja Blast, whey last, for 60 s so the cocoa dissolves.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM.
Cocoa bases often spin crumbly. Add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if needed.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the frozen brownie cubes and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once with a few brownie crumbs on top.

tips: Freeze the brownie cubes first; soft brownie smears into the ice cream instead of staying in chunks.
Cocoa makes spins more powdery, so the xanthan is especially worth adding here.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin with a splash of milk.
swaps: Protein brownie: use cubes of a chocolate protein bar (Yoga Bar, RiteBite Max Protein) instead of brownie.
No Amul High Protein Milk: use 370 ml toned milk and 35 g chocolate whey (about 44 g protein).
Mint brownie: add ¼ tsp peppermint essence to the base.
recipes.shop_note: Amul High Protein Milk: Blinkit, Zepto or shop.amul.com; stock comes and goes. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Alphonso Mango Shrikhand Froyo
recipes.subtitle: Aamrakhand, frozen and protein-packed
recipes.intro: Every Maharashtrian and Gujarati summer has a bowl of aamrakhand: thick yogurt, Alphonso pulp, saffron and elaichi. This pint keeps the flavour and adds a scoop of whey, so dessert out-proteins most shakes.

ingredients.note: or Amul Greek yogurt, or hung curd
Swad or Ratna's tin; Kesar pulp works

ingredients.item: saffron, soaked in warm milk, cooled

steps.text: Soak the saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 min until deep orange; cool to room temperature.
Blend yogurt, mango pulp, milk, saffron milk, sugar, cardamom, whey and xanthan in the Ninja Blast: two 45 s cycles, until silky.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint; it sits just under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump with a spoon, then run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Finish with saffron strands and slivered pistachios, like shrikhand at a wedding thali.

tips: Tinned pulp is sweeter than fresh. With fresh Alphonso, add 1 tbsp more sugar or the pint tastes flat frozen.
Hung curd is tangier and denser; thin it with 1 extra tbsp milk so the Blast can turn it over.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin on LITE ICE CREAM before serving.
swaps: Kesar-elaichi shrikhand: skip the mango; use 300 g yogurt, 30 g sugar and double the saffron.
Whey-free: use 250 g Epigamia Turbo Natural instead of the Greek yogurt and whey (still about 33 g protein).
Mango lassi pint: replace the milk and 50 g of the yogurt with 100 ml Amul High Protein Lassi (Plain).
recipes.shop_note: Alphonso pulp: Swad or Ratna's on Blinkit, Zepto, Amazon. Kesar: Baby Brand or Lion. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Epigamia Turbo Chocolate Pint
recipes.subtitle: One bottle, one tub, done
recipes.respin: Almost always 1–2 re-spins with 1 tbsp milk each
recipes.intro: Epigamia's Turbo Chocolate shake packs 25 g protein into 250 ml with no added sugar. Add Turbo's thick protein yogurt and cocoa, and it becomes a dense pint with over 40 g protein, for lazy nights.

ingredients.item: Epigamia Turbo Chocolate protein shake (25 g protein)
ingredients.note: or any 250 ml, 20 g+ protein shake

ingredients.item: Epigamia Turbo Natural yogurt (50 g protein tub)

steps.text: Shake the bottle well. Blend the shake, yogurt, cocoa and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 30 s.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint (about 400 ml, under MAX FILL). Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Let the pint sit 5 min on the counter, then run LITE ICE CREAM.
This lean base usually spins powdery. Add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if needed until glossy.
Eat from the pint, or top with dark chocolate shavings.

tips: Almost zero fat means the texture depends on the re-spin. For a creamier pint, blend in 1 tbsp peanut butter (adds about 95 kcal).
No Blast handy? Whisk everything in a bowl for a minute. The cocoa may speckle, but it spins out fine.
Leftovers turn rock hard. Flatten, refreeze and re-spin with a splash of milk.
swaps: Mocha: use Turbo Coffee and keep the cocoa.
Malai kulfi: use the Turbo 30 g Malai Kulfi shake, skip the cocoa and add a pinch of cardamom (about 48 g protein).
Cookies & cream: use Turbo Cookies & Cream, skip the cocoa, and MIX-IN 2 crushed Oreos after spinning.
recipes.shop_note: Turbo shakes and the 430 g Turbo yogurt tub (50 g protein): Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Mixed Berry Skyr Froyo
recipes.subtitle: Frozen berries, skyr and a little honey
recipes.respin: Re-spin once with 1–2 tbsp milk if crumbly
recipes.intro: Frozen mixed berries from the quick-commerce freezer aisle bring real berry flavour any month of the year. Blended with thick skyr and a little honey, they spin into a tart, magenta froyo.

ingredients.note: or Greek yogurt + ½ scoop more whey

steps.text: Let the berries sit 15 min to soften and release their juice.
Blend the berries and juice, skyr, milk, honey, whey and xanthan in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s until no chunks remain.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run SMOOTHIE BOWL; fruit sugars and skyr give a soft-serve texture. If the edges are crumbly, add 1–2 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve as a froyo cup or a breakfast bowl with granola and fresh berries.

tips: Berry mixes vary in tartness. The blended base should taste slightly too sweet, because freezing dulls sweetness.
For a seed-free pint, blend the berries alone first, strain through a tea strainer, then blend in the rest.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, then re-spin on SMOOTHIE BOWL.
swaps: Strawberry: use 160 g frozen or fresh strawberries and 1 tbsp more honey.
Turbo: swap the skyr for a 140 g Epigamia Turbo Mixed Berries cup plus 60 g Turbo Natural.
Sugar-free: replace the honey with 6 spoons Sugar Free Natura plus 1 tbsp milk; run LITE ICE CREAM instead.
recipes.shop_note: Frozen berries: Pluckk, Delishh or RealFrost on Blinkit/Zepto. Milky Mist Skyr: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Rasmalai Paneer Protein Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Kesar-elaichi malai, over 60 g protein
recipes.intro: Rasmalai is paneer soaking in saffron milk, so blending high-protein paneer into kesar milk is a short step. Blitzed smooth with condensed milk and cardamom, it tastes like the last bowl at a Bengali wedding.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature
ingredients.note: regular paneer: about 50 g protein total

ingredients.item: saffron, soaked in warm milk, cooled

steps.text: Soak the saffron in 1 tbsp warm milk for 10 min; cool. Crumble the paneer finely.
Blend the paneer with the 180 ml milk in the Ninja Blast, two or three 60 s cycles, until completely smooth.
Add condensed milk, saffron milk, cardamom, kewra and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If chalky, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and run MIX-IN.
Scatter a few saffron strands on top and serve at once.

tips: Graininess means under-blended paneer. Use it at room temperature and blend it with the milk alone first.
Rasmalai should taste clearly sweet. If your paneer is sour, add 1 more tbsp condensed milk.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Lower sugar: replace the condensed milk with 30 g milk powder and 7 spoons Sugar Free Natura; expect one more re-spin.
Angoori: MIX-IN 2 chopped Haldiram's rasgullas, squeezed dry, with the pistachios.
Regular paneer: use 200 g fresh malai paneer plus 15 g unflavoured whey; rest the base 2–3 min for the foam to settle.
recipes.shop_note: Amul High Protein Paneer: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket. Kewra water: kirana or Amazon. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Amul Protein Shake Pint Hack
recipes.subtitle: Two cartons in, one pint out
recipes.intro: Amul's High Protein Blueberry Shake packs 20 g protein into a 200 ml carton with no added sugar. Two cartons fill a pint to just under the line: snip, pour, freeze, spin.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Blueberry Shake (20 g protein each)

steps.text: Shake the cartons and blend both with the xanthan and cream in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. No Blast? Whisk hard in the pint.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle; pour into the pint, just under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Let it stand 5 min, then run LITE ICE CREAM.
Lean shakes need this: add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if still powdery.
Serve plain or with fresh blueberries.

tips: Without xanthan the pint is icier but still good; the pinch roughly halves the re-spins.
Freeze the shake in the CREAMi pint, never the carton. Only the pint locks into the machine.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin with a splash of milk.
swaps: Blueberry cheesecake: replace 60 ml of shake with 60 g Greek yogurt; MIX-IN 2 crushed digestives after spinning.
Kool Protein: use two 180 ml Amul Kool Protein bottles (10 g protein each) plus 15 g whey, for about 31 g.
Epigamia route: one 250 ml Turbo shake plus 150 g Turbo Natural yogurt (see Epigamia Turbo Chocolate Pint).
recipes.shop_note: Amul High Protein Blueberry Shake: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket or shop.amul.com. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Honey Anjeer Greek Froyo
recipes.subtitle: Soaked figs, honey and Turbo yogurt
recipes.intro: Anjeer ice cream is a dry-fruit-shop favourite, all jammy sweetness and crunchy seeds. Figs soaked overnight in milk blend with Turbo yogurt, honey and a spoon of cream, with chewy fig and walnut folded through.

steps.text: Soak the chopped figs in the milk, covered, in the fridge for at least 4 h or overnight.
Blend the figs and their milk in the Ninja Blast for 40 s. Add yogurt, honey, cream and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL and tap out air bubbles. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chopped figs and walnuts, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a thin drizzle of honey.

tips: Soak the figs cold, not in hot milk, so the base goes straight into the Blast with no cooling wait.
Turbo yogurt is almost fat-free; the 2 tbsp cream is what stops this pint going icy. Don't skip it.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Anjeer-akhrot kulfi: add ¼ tsp cardamom and 1 tbsp milk powder to the base.
Dates: use 50 g soft seedless dates (e.g. Lion) instead of figs, and cut the honey to 1 tbsp.
Skyr: use 230 g Milky Mist Skyr instead of Turbo; protein stays about the same.
recipes.shop_note: Dried figs: Happilo or Nutraj on Blinkit or Amazon. Epigamia Turbo yogurt: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Piña Colada Protein Froyo
recipes.subtitle: Pineapple, coconut milk, zero rum
recipes.intro: Goa shack flavours in a pint: sweet pineapple, rich coconut milk and Greek yogurt tang, with vanilla whey for protein. Entirely non-alcoholic, sunny yellow and finished with toasted coconut.

ingredients.note: fresh, or canned in juice, drained

steps.text: Blend pineapple, yogurt, coconut milk, sugar and salt in the Ninja Blast for 30 s. Add whey and xanthan; blend 20 s more.
Rest 2–3 min for the foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the toasted coconut and run MIX-IN.
Serve in a hollowed pineapple half or a chilled glass with a pineapple wedge.

tips: Fresh pineapple's bromelain can thin dairy and turn it slightly bitter if the base sits. Freeze straight away, or use canned.
Shake the coconut milk hard: the cream separates and you want both parts.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Whey-free: replace the yogurt and whey with 200 g Epigamia Turbo Natural (about 27 g protein).
Vegan-leaning: use plant protein (OZiva, MuscleBlaze) and coconut yogurt; add ½ scoop more protein to compensate.
Tropical: swap half the pineapple for ripe mango pulp.
recipes.shop_note: Coconut milk: Dabur Hommade or Real Thai on Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket. Xanthan gum: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Chikoo Malai Protein
recipes.subtitle: A Juhu-style chikoo scoop, with paneer
recipes.intro: Mumbai's Natural Ice Cream made chikoo famous: malty, brown-sugar sweet and a little grainy. Ripe chikoos blended with high-protein paneer and a splash of cream scoop like the real thing, with over 30 g protein.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature

steps.text: Peel the chikoos, remove the black seeds and white core strip, and chop roughly.
Blend the paneer and milk in the Ninja Blast, two 60 s cycles, until completely smooth.
Add chikoo, cream, condensed milk and xanthan; blend 30 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Top with small cubes of fresh chikoo.

tips: Use chikoos that give when pressed. Underripe fruit has latex that tastes chalky, and freezing makes it worse.
The fine grain is part of chikoo's charm, so don't chase a perfectly smooth base.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Chikoo-coffee: add 1 tsp instant coffee dissolved in 1 tbsp milk.
Yogurt route: replace the paneer and milk with 200 g Epigamia Turbo Natural (about 27 g protein).
Sitaphal: use 180 g deseeded custard-apple pulp; frozen pulp works off-season.
recipes.shop_note: Chikoo: Blinkit or Zepto fruit aisle, best Oct–Mar. Amul High Protein Paneer: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BigBasket.

recipes.title: Gulkand Rose Protein Pint
recipes.subtitle: Rose lassi and gulkand, paan-shop style
recipes.intro: Gulkand, the sticky rose-petal preserve tucked into every meetha paan, makes a floral, jammy base. Amul High Protein Rose Lassi and high-protein paneer bring the protein; pistachio and rose petals bring crunch.

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Lassi, Rose (15 g protein)
ingredients.note: or 150 g Greek yogurt, 50 ml milk

ingredients.item: Amul High Protein Paneer, room temperature

steps.text: Blend the paneer and milk in the Ninja Blast for 60 s until completely smooth.
Add the rose lassi, gulkand and xanthan; blend 30 s.
Rest 2–3 min for any foam to settle, then pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and rose petals, and run MIX-IN.
Serve with a small spoon of gulkand on each scoop.

tips: Gulkand brands vary in sweetness. If the blended base tastes mild, add 1 more tbsp gulkand before freezing.
Blending the paneer with only the milk first is the trick to a smooth, not grainy, pint.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Meetha paan: blend 2 Calcutta paan leaves (stems removed) into the base; MIX-IN 1 tbsp tutti-frutti and 1 tsp sweet saunf.
Rose falooda: MIX-IN 1 tbsp soaked, drained sabja seeds and drizzle Rooh Afza on top.
Lighter, tangier: replace the paneer with 120 g Epigamia Turbo Natural.
recipes.shop_note: Amul High Protein Rose Lassi: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Gulkand: Dabur or Patanjali. Rose petals: Urban Platter on Amazon.

recipes.title: Guava Chilli Froyo
recipes.subtitle: Pink amrood with a chilli-salt finish
recipes.intro: Winter in India means the thela-wala rubbing halved pink guavas with chilli and kala namak. This froyo blends sieved guava with protein yogurt and a pinch of black salt; the chilli dust goes on at the table.

ingredients.item: to finish: Kashmiri chilli powder, kala namak, chaat masala

steps.text: Quarter the guavas, blend with the milk in the Ninja Blast for 20 s, then press through a sieve to remove the seeds.
Rinse the Blast. Blend the sieved pulp, yogurt, sugar, cream, kala namak and xanthan for 30 s until smooth and pink.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL and tap out air bubbles. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run LITE ICE CREAM.
Add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN; repeat once if still crumbly.
Dust each scoop with a pinch of the chilli-salt mix and a squeeze of lime.

tips: Choose fragrant, slightly soft pink guavas such as Allahabad Surkha. White guavas work, but the pint turns beige.
Don't skip sieving: guava seeds feel like grit in a frozen pint.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin; add the masala only after scooping.
swaps: Kairi twist: use 150 g ripe mango pulp plus 2 tbsp raw-mango pulp instead of guava, with the same masala.
Sweet only: skip the kala namak and chilli masala, and finish with a drizzle of honey.
Greek route: use 250 g Epigamia Greek Natural plus 15 g whey and drop the milk; rest the base 2–3 min for foam.
recipes.shop_note: Pink guava: Blinkit or Zepto fruit aisle, best Nov–Feb. Epigamia Turbo yogurt: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart. Xanthan: Urban Platter, Amazon.

recipes.title: Malai Kulfi
recipes.subtitle: Slow-reduced milk, cardamom and saffron
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: The matka kulfi of every summer evening, reduced the patient way in a kadhai and finished with Milkmaid. The CREAMi turns the dense, caramel-edged milk into a spoonable scoop that still tastes of the kulfi-wala's cart.

ingredients.note: or any 6% milk; reduced to 240 ml

steps.text: Simmer the milk in a wide, heavy kadhai on medium-low for about 25 min, stirring and scraping the sides in, until reduced to 240 ml.
Stir in the Milkmaid, cardamom, saffron and khoya, if using. Simmer 2–3 min, then take off the heat.
Cool to room temperature, about 45 min, or 15 min over an ice-water bath. Never put a warm base in the Blast.
Blend the cooled base and cream in the Ninja Blast for 20–30 s; any longer and the cream starts to whip.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the pistachios and almonds, and run MIX-IN.
Scoop at once, or rest 5 min for a denser, more kulfi-like bite.

tips: Use your widest heavy pan; more surface means faster reduction and fewer scorched spots.
Measure the cooled reduction. Over 250 ml and the base will pass MAX FILL once the cream goes in; drink the extra.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again. The nuts soften a little.
swaps: Protein: reduce toned milk, use 50 g Milkmaid, swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Kesar pista: double the saffron, bloomed in 1 tbsp warm milk, and use 20 g pistachios as the only mix-in.
Rabri kulfi: add the 30 g khoya and 1 tbsp milk powder to the reduction for a grainier texture.
recipes.shop_note: Khoya: local mithai shop or Amul khoya on BigBasket. Saffron: Baby Brand or Lion on Blinkit or Zepto.

recipes.title: Alphonso Aamras Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Ratnagiri mango pulp, cream and cardamom
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: Aamras-puri lunches in May are the reason this pint exists. A tin of Alphonso or Kesar pulp makes it possible in December too, and cream rounds the fruit's tang into mango-kulfi territory.

ingredients.item: Alphonso or Kesar mango pulp, sweetened
ingredients.note: Swad tin; fresh pulp needs 1 tbsp sugar

steps.text: Chill the mango pulp and cream for a few hours so the base starts cold.
Blend the pulp, Milkmaid, milk, cardamom and salt in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 15 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
If the top has a hump, let the pint sit 5 min. Run ICE CREAM.
If the edges look powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once.
Top with fresh mango cubes in season.

tips: Taste the pulp first. Tinned Kesar is usually sweeter than Alphonso; unsweetened Harvesta pulp needs 2 extra tbsp sugar.
Fresh mangoes must be fully ripe and fibre-free. Stringy Totapuri makes a grainy, sour pint.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Protein: replace cream and milk with 180 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM (adds about 33 g protein).
Kesar-elaichi: bloom 10 saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm milk, cool, and add with the cardamom.
Mango lassi: cut the cream to 100 ml and replace the milk with 100 g thick curd for a gentle tang.
recipes.shop_note: Mango pulp: Swad Alphonso or Kesar, or Harvesta (unsweetened), on Blinkit, Zepto and Amazon.

recipes.title: Filter Coffee Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Chicory decoction with kaapi sweetness
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: A tumbler of Chennai degree kaapi, frozen. A thick chicory-blend decoction gives the bitter, toasty edge instant coffee never quite manages, and Milkmaid brings back the sweetness of a darshini counter.

ingredients.note: Cothas, Narasu's, Leo or Bru Green Label
1 tsp more for very sweet kaapi

steps.text: Tamp the coffee lightly into the top of a South Indian filter, pour in the boiling water and leave 12–15 min to drip.
Collect about 60 ml decoction and cool to room temperature, about 15 min. Never put hot decoction in the Blast.
Blend the decoction, milk, Milkmaid and sugar in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 15 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve in a steel davara-tumbler, dusted with coffee powder.

tips: No filter? Steep the powder in the boiling water for 10 min, then strain through a paper filter or muslin.
Use only the first, thick drip; a second pour of water makes a watery, icy pint.
Instant shortcut: dissolve 2 tsp Bru Instant in 3 tbsp hot water, cool, and use instead of decoction.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey, sugar for 3 spoons Sugar Free Natura; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Jaggery kaapi: replace the sugar with 15 g jaggery powder dissolved in the warm decoction.
Mocha kaapi: blend 1 tbsp cocoa in with the milk.

egg_option.title: Kaapi custard with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Adds a cook step. Heat the milk and sugar until steaming, slowly whisk into 2 yolks, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Cut milk to 150 ml. Add decoction and Milkmaid; cool fully.

recipes.shop_note: Filter coffee: Cothas, Narasu's or Bru Green Label on Amazon, BigBasket, Instamart. Steel filter: Amazon or any utensil shop.

recipes.title: Meetha Paan Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Fresh betel, gulkand and tutti-frutti
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: Everything a paanwala folds into a meetha paan goes into this pint: cool betel leaf, gulkand, fennel and jewel-bright tutti-frutti. Fresh leaves give pale green flecks and a peppery perfume no paan essence can copy.

ingredients.item: fresh paan (betel) leaves, Calcutta or Maghai

steps.text: Wash and dry the paan leaves. Cut out the stems and thick central vein, which taste bitter, and tear the leaves.
Blend the leaves, milk, gulkand, saunf and Milkmaid in the Ninja Blast for 45–60 s, until the leaves are fine specks.
Add the cream; blend 15 s more. For a smoother pint, strain through a tea strainer.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the tutti-frutti and coated saunf, and run MIX-IN.
Drizzle with a little gulkand and top with a sliver of paan leaf.

tips: Stick to 4 leaves. More turns the pint grassy and bitter; fewer leave only a faint perfume.
Calcutta (Bangla) leaves are sharper and more peppery; Maghai and Banarasi are milder. Ask your paanwala for fresh, unblemished leaves.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin. Add coated saunf only on the first serve; it bleeds colour once frozen.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey and halve the Milkmaid; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Chocolate paan: swap the tutti-frutti for 25 g chopped Amul dark chocolate.
Banarasi style: blend in 4 cardamom pods and 1 tsp desiccated coconut.
recipes.shop_note: Paan leaves: local paan shop, or betel leaves for puja on Blinkit/Zepto. Gulkand, tutti-frutti: Blinkit, BigBasket, Amazon.

recipes.title: Gulab Jamun Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Rose-cardamom cream with jamun chunks
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: Hot gulab jamun with vanilla ice cream is a wedding buffet staple; this pint folds the two into one scoop. A rose-cardamom base, sweetened partly with jamun syrup, carries chewy pieces of tinned jamun.

ingredients.item: gulab jamun syrup, from the tin

mixins.item: tinned gulab jamun, in 1 cm pieces

steps.text: Lift 2 jamuns from the tin, gently squeeze out the syrup and chop into 1 cm pieces. Chill, covered.
Blend the milk, Milkmaid, jamun syrup, cardamom and rose water in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 15 s more.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Freeze the jamun pieces for 20–30 min first. Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add jamun and pistachios, and run MIX-IN.
Scoop at once, beside one warm gulab jamun for the buffet effect.

tips: Firm the jamun pieces in the freezer first. Straight from the tin, the blade smears them into the base.
Rose waters vary in strength. Start with ½ tsp; too much tastes of soap, not mithai.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin. The jamun pieces stay chewy after a second freeze.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey, keeping the jamun mix-in; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Kala jamun or rasgulla: use the same amount of chopped kala jamun, or squeezed rasgulla with its syrup.
Kesar jamun: bloom 10 saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm milk; cool and add with the rose water.
recipes.shop_note: Tinned gulab jamun: Haldiram's or Bikano on Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket. Edible rose water: Puramio or Mr. Merchant on Blinkit.

recipes.title: Sitaphal Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Custard apple, Naturals-style, barely sweetened
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: Naturals made sitaphal the flavour people queue for, and the secret is real fruit with very little else. Custard apple is already creamy and honey-sweet, so it needs only cream, milk and a spoon of Milkmaid.

steps.text: Split the fruit, scoop out the segments and pick out every seed by hand; one crushed seed makes the pint bitter. Discard core and skin.
Blend the pulp, milk and Milkmaid in the Ninja Blast for 20 s. Add the cream; blend 10–15 s until just smooth.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve plain; sitaphal is delicate, so skip strong toppings.

tips: Season runs roughly September to December. Off-season, thaw Fooda frozen custard apple pulp in the fridge overnight.
Use only fully ripe fruit that gives when pressed; underripe sitaphal tastes starchy and flat frozen.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey and cut Milkmaid to 25 g; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Ramphal or chikoo: use the same weight of ripe, deseeded ramphal or peeled chikoo pulp.
Sitaphal rabri: blend in 30 g crumbled khoya and cut the milk to 50 ml.
recipes.shop_note: Fresh sitaphal: Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket in season. Frozen pulp: Fooda Custard Apple on BigBasket.

recipes.title: Tender Coconut Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Soft malai, coconut water, chewy bits
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: Naturals' tender coconut converts people who think they dislike coconut. Two malai-wale nariyal give soft, jelly-like flesh and sweet water; most of the malai goes into the base, the rest in chewy pieces.

ingredients.note: coconut water is only lightly sweet

mixins.item: tender coconut malai, in 1 cm pieces, chilled

steps.text: Measure 100 ml coconut water. Scoop out the malai, scrape off any brown skin, and set 50 g aside for the mix-in.
Blend 100 g malai with the coconut water, Milkmaid, milk and sugar in the Ninja Blast for 30–40 s until smooth. Add cream; blend 10 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chilled malai pieces and run MIX-IN.
Serve at once, while the malai pieces are soft and chewy.

tips: Ask for a 'malai wala' coconut with thin, soft flesh. Thick, mature malai blends grainy and tastes oily.
Keep mix-in pieces small. Big chunks of malai turn icy when refrozen.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving again.
swaps: Protein: swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey and skip the sugar; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Vegan: use thick coconut cream for the dairy cream, coconut milk for the milk, and 50 g sugar instead of Milkmaid.
Coconut-jaggery: replace the sugar and Milkmaid with 60 g jaggery powder dissolved in the coconut water.
recipes.shop_note: Tender coconuts: local nariyal-wala or Blinkit/Zepto. Packaged coconut water: Paper Boat or Raw Pressery on Blinkit, Amazon.

recipes.title: Masala Chai Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Kadak doodh-patti chai with Parle-G
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN once
recipes.intro: Strong, spiced chai with a Parle-G dunked in it is India's real comfort food. Brewing the tea in full cream milk keeps it bold enough to survive freezing, and the biscuit softens just as it does in the cup.

ingredients.note: Tata Tea Gold, Red Label or Wagh Bakri

ingredients.item: 4 green cardamom pods, 2 cloves, 2 cm cinnamon, 4 peppercorns, crushed

steps.text: Boil the milk with the crushed spices and saunth. Add the tea and simmer on low for 6–8 min, until deep tan.
Strain, pressing the leaves; you want about 250 ml. Stir in the Milkmaid and sugar while hot.
Cool to room temperature, about 40 min, or over an ice-water bath. Never pour hot chai into the Blast.
Blend the cooled chai and cream in the Ninja Blast for 15–20 s.
Pour into the pint below MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the Parle-G pieces and run MIX-IN.
Serve in a kulhad with a pinch of cinnamon on top.

tips: Fresh ginger can curdle hot milk; saunth gives the same warmth with no risk.
Brew stronger than you would drink. Cold dulls spice and tannin, so chai that tastes too kadak hot is right frozen.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and re-spin. The biscuit softens more on day two, which many prefer.
swaps: Protein: use toned milk and Sugar Free Natura; swap cream for 120 g Greek yogurt + 30 g whey; rest for foam, run LITE ICE CREAM.
Elaichi chai: skip the other spices and use 8 crushed cardamom pods.
Chai-rusk: swap the Parle-G for 2 broken Britannia Toastea rusks.

egg_option.title: Chai custard with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks in a bowl; slowly whisk in the hot sweetened chai, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Cut cream to 90 ml. Cool fully; Blast.

recipes.shop_note: Saunth and tea masala: Everest or MDH at any kirana or Blinkit. Kulhads: Amazon.

recipes.title: Real Vanilla Bean Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Philadelphia-style, eggless, flecked with seeds
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; 1 re-spin with 1 tbsp milk if crumbly
recipes.intro: Philadelphia-style means no custard and no eggs: just cream, milk, sugar and a real vanilla pod. The black seeds taste nothing like bottled essence. This is the plain scoop every gulab jamun and warm brownie deserves.

ingredients.item: Amul Gold full cream milk, chilled

ingredients.note: or 1½ tsp pure extract, not essence

steps.text: Split the pod, scrape out the seeds and rub them into the sugar with your fingertips so they don't clump.
Optional: steep the scraped pod in the cold milk, refrigerated, 4 hours or overnight for deeper flavour. Remove it before blending.
Blend milk, vanilla sugar and salt in the Ninja Blast 40 seconds until the sugar dissolves. Add the cream; blend only 5–10 seconds so it doesn't whip.
Pour into the pint, under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump with a spoon and run ICE CREAM. If the edges look crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Serve at once for soft-serve texture, or freeze 20 minutes for firmer, rounder scoops.

tips: Dry the scraped pod and bury it in a jar of sugar. In a week you have vanilla sugar for chai biscuits and the next pint.
The base should taste slightly too sweet at room temperature. Cold dulls sweetness, and sugar keeps the pint soft.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on ICE CREAM before serving.
swaps: Protein: use 280 ml milk and 100 ml cream, 40 g sugar, 1 scoop vanilla whey, ⅛ tsp xanthan. Rest foam; LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin.
Milkmaid vanilla: replace the sugar with 80 g Nestlé Milkmaid for a rounder, kulfi-leaning scoop.
Cookies and cream: after spinning, run MIX-IN with ¼ cup crushed Oreo or Hide & Seek.

egg_option.title: Cooked French custard, 3 yolks
egg_option.text: Adds a cook step. Heat milk and seeds until steaming. Whisk 3 yolks with the sugar, slowly whisk in the hot milk, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Use 150 ml cream.

recipes.shop_note: Vanilla pods and pure extract: Urban Platter or Sprig on Amazon; Kerala-grown pods online.

recipes.title: Belgian Dark Chocolate Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Cocoa plus real melted dark chocolate
recipes.intro: Cocoa gives chocolate flavour; real melted dark chocolate gives the dense, fudgy body of a good gelato counter. Belgian Callebaut callets are easy to order online, but a bar of Amul Dark works beautifully too.

ingredients.note: deepens chocolate; won't taste of coffee

steps.text: Whisk 120 ml of the milk with cocoa, sugar, salt and coffee in a saucepan. Simmer gently 1 minute, whisking, until smooth.
Off the heat, stir in the chopped chocolate until melted and glossy.
Whisk in the remaining 100 ml cold milk and the cream. Cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes; never blend a warm base.
Blend in the Ninja Blast 20–30 seconds until silky. Rest 1 minute for bubbles to settle, then pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
If the top is domed, let it sit 5–10 minutes, then run ICE CREAM. If powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Finish with a pinch of flaky salt or crushed Oreo.

tips: Always bloom cocoa in hot milk. Blended cold, it tastes dusty and leaves a gritty film.
Check the label lists cocoa butter, not vegetable fat. Compound 'chocolate-flavoured' slabs give a waxy finish.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN; chocolate pints almost always need it the second time.
swaps: Protein: 340 ml milk (no cream), 35 g sugar, 30 g chocolate; blast in 1 scoop chocolate whey + xanthan. Rest foam; LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin.
Double chocolate: after spinning, MIX-IN ¼ cup chopped dark chocolate.
Mocha: raise the instant coffee to 2 tsp.

egg_option.title: Custard chocolate with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Simmer the cocoa milk without sugar. Whisk 2 yolks with the sugar, slowly whisk in the hot cocoa milk, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Melt in chocolate; use 90 ml cream.

recipes.shop_note: Callebaut 811 callets: Amazon or BigBasket. Cocoa and Amul Dark: Blinkit/Zepto or any kirana.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Praline Crunch
recipes.subtitle: India's parlour favourite, made from scratch
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; 1 re-spin with 1 tbsp milk if crumbly
recipes.intro: Every Indian parlour has a butterscotch tub, usually bright yellow and loud with essence. This one gets its flavour honestly, from caramel cooked with Amul butter and cream, then studded with crunchy cashew praline.

ingredients.note: if unsalted, add a pinch of salt

ingredients.item: Amul Gold full cream milk, chilled

steps.text: Melt 60 g sugar in a heavy pan on medium-low, swirling, until deep amber, 5–6 minutes.
Off heat, stir in the butter, then slowly add the warm cream; it bubbles hard. Stir on low until smooth; add Milkmaid and vanilla.
Praline: caramelise 40 g sugar to amber, stir in the cashews, spread thin on butter paper. When glass-hard, crush to pea-sized bits.
Whisk in the cold milk and cool to room temperature, 30–40 minutes. Never put a warm base in the Blast.
Add the essence and blend in the Ninja Blast 20–30 seconds. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump and run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add ⅓ cup praline and run MIX-IN. Serve with extra praline on top.

tips: Take the caramel to deep amber, the colour of strong chai. Pale tastes only sweet; smoking turns bitter. Warm cream splutters less.
Praline turns sticky within a day in humid weather. Store it airtight and crush just before using.
swaps: Short cut: skip the praline and MIX-IN store-bought butterscotch nuts (Morde) or crushed peanut chikki.
Protein: swap the cream for 120 ml warm milk; once cool, blast in 1 scoop vanilla whey, rest foam. LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin, then MIX-IN.
Butterscotch walnut: use half walnuts, half cashews in the praline.

egg_option.title: Caramel custard with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks in a bowl; slowly whisk in the hot caramel-cream, then return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Whisk in the cold milk, cut to 170 ml. Cool; Blast.

recipes.shop_note: Butterscotch essence (optional): Bush on Blinkit/Amazon. Ready butterscotch nuts: Morde on Amazon.

recipes.title: Eggless Cookie Dough Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: Brown sugar base, safe-to-eat atta dough
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; 1 re-spin with 1 tbsp milk if crumbly
recipes.intro: Raw cookie dough is the best part of baking, and with no eggs and heat-treated atta it is safe to eat. The toffee-ish brown sugar base tastes like the middle of a warm chocolate chip cookie.

ingredients.item: Amul Gold full cream milk, chilled
whole wheat atta, for the dough
Amul butter, softened, for the dough
mini chocolate chips, for the dough

steps.text: Heat-treat the atta: dry-roast on low, stirring constantly, 4–5 minutes until toasty and hot throughout (or microwave in 30-second bursts to 75 °C). Sift; cool.
Mix the atta with butter, 15 g brown sugar, milk, a drop of vanilla and a pinch of salt. Fold in chips, roll pea-sized balls; freeze.
Blend milk, 60 g brown sugar, vanilla and salt in the Ninja Blast 45 seconds until no grains remain. Add the cream; blend only 5–10 seconds.
Pour into the pint under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h, with the dough balls boxed alongside.
Flatten any hump and run ICE CREAM. If dry or crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, drop in the frozen dough balls and run MIX-IN. Serve straight away.

tips: Raw flour can carry bacteria, so never skip heat-treating. Atta tastes nutty, like digestive biscuits; maida is closer to American cookie dough.
Keep the dough balls small and frozen hard. Big, soft lumps smear instead of staying as chunks.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on ICE CREAM; the dough bits survive well.
swaps: Protein: swap the cream for 160 ml milk, cut sugar to 40 g, blast in 1 scoop vanilla whey. Rest foam; LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin, MIX-IN.
Gluten-free: heat-treat 30 g almond flour or certified gluten-free oat flour instead of atta.
Biscoff dough: replace the butter with 1 tbsp Lotus Biscoff spread and skip the chips.
recipes.shop_note: Mini chocolate chips: Morde or Hershey's on Blinkit/Amazon. Brown sugar: BigBasket or any kirana.

recipes.title: Fresh Pudina Choc Chip
recipes.subtitle: Real mint leaves, no green essence
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; 1 re-spin with 1 tbsp milk if powdery
recipes.intro: Most mint choc chip gets its taste and neon colour from a bottle. Steeping a big bunch of chutney pudina gives a softer, garden-fresh mint. Expect a pale ivory-green scoop flecked with dark chocolate.

mixins.item: dark chocolate chips or chopped dark chocolate

steps.text: Rinse and dry the mint, then scrunch it in your hands to bruise the leaves and release the oils.
Heat milk, sugar and salt until steaming and the sugar dissolves; don't boil. Off the heat, push the mint under, cover and steep 25–30 minutes.
Strain, pressing hard on the leaves. Cool the minty milk to room temperature.
Blend the minty milk and cream in the Ninja Blast 10 seconds. It should taste slightly over-minty and over-sweet; freezing mutes both.
Pour into the pint under MAX FILL. Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump and run ICE CREAM. If the edges look powdery, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the chocolate and run MIX-IN. Serve immediately.

tips: Steep no longer than 40 minutes and never boil the leaves, or they turn bitter. For brighter mint, cold-steep overnight in the fridge instead.
For fine flecks, melt the chocolate with 1 tsp coconut oil and drizzle it into the well before MIX-IN; it shatters into shards.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN before serving.
swaps: Want it green? Blend 6–8 raw mint leaves into the cooled base, then strain again for a natural pale green.
Protein: swap the cream for 160 ml milk, cut sugar to 40 g, blast in 1 scoop vanilla whey. Rest foam; LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin, MIX-IN.
Mint Oreo: replace the chocolate with 3 crushed Oreos (about ⅓ cup).

egg_option.title: Mint custard with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Rewarm the strained minty milk until steaming. Whisk 2 yolks, slowly whisk in the hot milk, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Cut cream to 140 ml. Cool fully; Blast.

recipes.shop_note: Fresh pudina: any sabziwala or Blinkit/Zepto. Dark chocolate chips: Morde or Amul on Amazon/BigBasket.

recipes.title: Black Forest Ice Cream
recipes.subtitle: The bakery birthday cake, in a scoop
recipes.intro: Black Forest was the birthday cake of every 90s Indian childhood. This pint keeps the trio of chocolate, cream and cherries: cocoa ice cream, a tart homemade compote and dark chocolate shavings.

ingredients.item: pitted cherries, halved, for the compote

mixins.item: dark chocolate shavings (Amul Dark or Morde)

steps.text: Whisk 120 ml of the milk with cocoa, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Simmer gently 1–2 minutes, whisking, until glossy.
Off heat, whisk in the remaining cold milk, the cream and vanilla. Cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook cherries, sugar and lemon juice on medium 5–6 minutes. Stir in the slurry; cook 1 minute until jammy. Cool, then refrigerate.
Blend the cooled chocolate base in the Ninja Blast 20–30 seconds. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump and run ICE CREAM. If crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add 3 tbsp cold compote and the shavings, and run MIX-IN.
Top with leftover compote, extra shavings and a dollop of whipped cream for full bakery effect.

tips: The compote must be fridge-cold and thick. Warm, runny compote melts the ice cream around it and refreezes as icy streaks.
Shave chocolate straight off a cold bar with a vegetable peeler; the curls survive MIX-IN instead of turning to dust.
swaps: Short cut: use 3 tbsp drained, chopped canned cherries (Druk), or cherry jam loosened with a squeeze of lemon.
Protein: swap the cream for milk, cut sugar to 40 g; once cool, blast in 1 scoop chocolate whey. Rest foam; LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin, MIX-IN.
Cake crumbs: swap the shavings for 2 tbsp crumbled chocolate sponge or brownie.

egg_option.title: Fudgier base with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks in a bowl; slowly whisk in the hot cocoa milk, then stir on low heat to 80–82 °C until it coats a spoon. Add only 80 ml cold milk with the cream. Cool; Blast.

recipes.shop_note: Frozen cherries: Frugivore on BigBasket. Canned: Druk Red Cherry in syrup (BigBasket). Fresh Himachal/Kashmiri cherries May–July.

recipes.title: Rocky Road (Gelatin-Free)
recipes.subtitle: Chocolate, veg marshmallows, peanuts, chocolate chunks
recipes.intro: Rocky road is the bumpy one: chocolate ice cream crowded with soft marshmallows, salty peanuts and dark chocolate. Most marshmallows sold in India contain gelatin, so buy a gelatin-free brand with the green dot.

mixins.note: Kandee Factory Marshmelts; snip if large

steps.text: Whisk 120 ml of the milk with cocoa, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Simmer gently 1–2 minutes, whisking, until glossy.
Off heat, whisk in the Milkmaid, remaining cold milk and cream. Cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Blend the cooled base in the Ninja Blast 20–30 seconds. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h. Put the marshmallows in the freezer for the last hour.
Flatten any hump and run ICE CREAM. If dry or crumbly, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the marshmallows, peanuts and chocolate, and run MIX-IN.
Scatter extra marshmallows and peanuts on top; for a s'mores finish, torch the marshmallows for a few seconds.

tips: Kandee Factory Marshmelts are gelatin-free. With any other brand, read the ingredients for gelatin and look for the green dot.
Chill the marshmallows first; warm ones turn sticky and smear instead of staying as soft pillows.
Leftovers: flatten, refreeze and RE-SPIN. Nuts and chocolate hold up; the marshmallows turn chewier, which many people love.
swaps: Swap the peanuts for toasted almonds or walnuts, or crushed peanut chikki for extra crunch.
Protein: swap the cream for milk and skip the Milkmaid; once cool, blast in 1 scoop chocolate whey. Rest foam; LITE ICE CREAM, re-spin, MIX-IN.
Nutella road: swap the chocolate chunks for 1 tbsp Nutella in the well.
recipes.shop_note: Gelatin-free marshmallows: Kandee Factory Marshmelts, online or on Amazon; always check for the green dot.

recipes.title: Sicilian Pistachio Gelato
recipes.subtitle: Real pistachios, honest khaki colour
recipes.respin: Usually none; if crumbly, 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN
recipes.intro: In Bronte, Sicily, pistachio gelato is dusty olive-khaki, because that is the colour of ground pistachios. The neon-green mall scoop is food colour. This one tastes of toasted nut, salt and cream.

ingredients.note: or 55 g pure pistachio paste, unsoaked
Amul Spray or any whole milk powder

steps.text: Toast the pistachios in a dry pan 3 minutes. Soak in boiling water 15 minutes, rub off loose skins for a greener tint, and drain.
In a heavy pan, whisk sugar, cornflour, milk powder and salt with 60 ml of the cold milk until smooth.
Add the remaining milk and cream. Cook on medium-low, whisking, 5–6 minutes until it coats a spoon like thin custard. Don't boil hard.
Press cling film onto the surface and cool fully to room temperature, about 45 minutes.
Blend the cooled base and pistachios in the Blast 60 seconds (2–3 cycles) until silky. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO. If crumbly at the edges, add 1 tbsp milk and RE-SPIN.
Finish with chopped pistachios and a tiny pinch of flaky salt.

tips: For the smoothest texture, blend the nuts with half the base into a thick paste first, then add the rest. Fine specks are normal.
Buy plain, uncoloured pistachios. Roasted salted snack pistachios work if rinsed and dried; then skip the added salt.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO before serving.
swaps: Protein: cut milk to 230 ml; blast 1 scoop vanilla whey into the cooled base. Rest foam 2–3 minutes; expect one RE-SPIN. Adds 24 g protein.
Pista-elaichi: blend in the seeds of 3 green cardamoms with the nuts for a kulfi-leaning scoop.
Pistachio praline: caramelise 2 tbsp chopped pistachios in 1 tbsp sugar, cool, crush, add to a 4 cm well and run MIX-IN.

egg_option.title: Custard-style with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks with the sugar, milk powder and salt. Heat milk and cream until steaming, pour slowly onto the yolks, return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 240 ml milk.

recipes.shop_note: Unsalted pistachios: Happilo or Nutraj on BigBasket/Amazon. Pistachio paste: Amazon; choose '100% pistachio', no colour.

recipes.title: Stracciatella
recipes.subtitle: Milk gelato, shattered dark chocolate
recipes.intro: Stracciatella means 'little shreds': warm chocolate drizzled into cold gelato snaps into thin, irregular shards. The CREAMi MIX-IN cycle does this beautifully, and every spoonful crackles.

ingredients.note: Amul Spray or any whole milk powder

mixins.note: keeps the shards thin and snappy

steps.text: In a heavy pan, whisk sugar, cornflour, milk powder and salt with 60 ml of the cold milk until smooth.
Add the remaining milk and cream. Cook on medium-low, whisking, 5–6 minutes until it coats a spoon. Don't boil hard.
Press cling film onto the surface and cool fully to room temperature.
Blend the cooled base in the Blast 30 seconds to smooth out lumps. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO. Meanwhile, melt the chocolate with the coconut oil in 20-second microwave bursts; cool 2 minutes until just warm.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom. Drizzle the chocolate into the well and over the top, then run MIX-IN. Serve at once.

tips: The chocolate must be fluid but only warm. Too hot melts the gelato into streaks; too cool clumps instead of shattering.
Drizzle a thin stream from a spoon held high. Thinner streams make finer, more classic shreds.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO; the shards survive fine.
swaps: Protein: cut milk to 270 ml; blast 1 scoop vanilla whey into the cooled base. Rest foam 2–3 minutes; expect one RE-SPIN before MIX-IN.
Mint stracciatella: steep a handful of fresh pudina in the hot base 15 minutes, then strain before cooling.
Use ghee instead of coconut oil if you prefer; the shards will be slightly softer.

egg_option.title: Crema base with 3 yolks
egg_option.text: Richer than the egg-free Bergamo original. Whisk 3 yolks with the sugar; slowly pour in the steaming milk and cream, return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 260 ml milk.

recipes.shop_note: Dark chocolate: Amul Dark or Morde on Blinkit/Zepto. Coconut oil: Parachute or KLF on any grocery app.

recipes.title: Fior di Latte
recipes.subtitle: The purest milk gelato
recipes.intro: Italian gelaterias judge each other on fior di latte, 'flower of milk': no vanilla, no egg, nowhere to hide. Made with good full cream milk, it tastes like the cleanest, coldest malai.

ingredients.note: the freshest pouch milk you can buy
Amul Spray; boosts milky flavour and body

steps.text: In a heavy pan, whisk sugar, cornflour, milk powder and salt with 60 ml of the cold milk until completely smooth.
Add the remaining milk and cream. Cook on medium-low, whisking constantly, 5–6 minutes until it coats a spoon. Keep it just below a boil.
Press cling film onto the surface and cool fully to room temperature.
Blend the cooled base in the Blast 30 seconds until glossy. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO.
Serve plain, with honey, olive oil and sea salt, or with warm gulab jamun.

tips: With so few ingredients, milk quality is everything. Fresh pouch full cream milk beats UHT tetra packs, which can taste cooked.
If the base catches on the pan, don't scrape the scorched layer in. A burnt note is impossible to hide here.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO before serving.
swaps: Protein: replace the milk powder with 1 scoop unflavoured whey, blasted into the cooled base, and cut milk to 290 ml. Rest foam; expect one RE-SPIN.
Vanilla gelato: add ½ tsp vanilla extract or half a pod's seeds at the BLAST stage.
Gulkand ripple: after spinning, spoon 2 tbsp gulkand into a 4 cm well and run MIX-IN for rose-petal streaks through the milk.

egg_option.title: Crema-style: becomes classic Crema
egg_option.text: Yolks turn this into Crema, a different Italian classic. Whisk 3 yolks with the sugar, slowly pour in steaming milk and cream, return to low heat, stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 270 ml milk.

recipes.shop_note: Milk powder: Amul Spray on Blinkit/Zepto/BigBasket. Avoid dairy whiteners; they contain added sugar.

recipes.title: Tiramisu Gelato
recipes.subtitle: Coffee, cream cheese, soaked biscuit
recipes.intro: Everything good about tiramisu in a scoop: a tangy coffee base standing in for mascarpone, chunks of coffee-soaked biscuit and a dark dusting of cocoa. Non-alcoholic, and far easier than layering a dish.

ingredients.note: D'lecta or Flanders; or thick hung curd

mixins.item: Britannia Marie Gold, in 2 cm pieces

mixins.note: ½ tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp water

steps.text: In a heavy pan, whisk sugar and cornflour with 60 ml of the cold milk until smooth. Dissolve the coffee in 1 tbsp hot water.
Add the remaining milk, cream and coffee. Cook on medium-low, whisking, 5–6 minutes until it coats a spoon. Don't boil hard.
Press on cling film and cool fully. Meanwhile, dip the biscuit pieces in the soaking coffee for 2 seconds each and freeze them flat.
Blend the cooled base with the cream cheese in the Blast 30–45 seconds until smooth. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h. Box the soaked biscuits and keep them frozen.
Run GELATO.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the frozen biscuit pieces, sift in the cocoa and run MIX-IN.
Dust generously with more cocoa and serve.

tips: Freezing the soaked biscuits keeps them as distinct, cakey chunks. Added unfrozen, they turn to mush during MIX-IN.
Add cream cheese at the BLAST stage, never to the hot pan, or it can turn grainy and lose its tang.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO; the biscuit stays soft and cake-like.
swaps: Protein: cut milk to 200 ml, replace the cream cheese with 80 g Greek yogurt, blast in 1 scoop coffee whey. Rest foam; expect one RE-SPIN.
Hung curd: strain 120 g dahi overnight and use the ~60 g thick curd in place of cream cheese; tangier, lighter.
Gluten-free: use gluten-free cookies, or skip the biscuits and add 2 tbsp grated dark chocolate.

egg_option.title: Zabaione-style with 3 yolks
egg_option.text: Closer to real tiramisu. Whisk 3 yolks with the sugar, slowly pour in the steaming coffee-milk and cream, return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 210 ml milk.

recipes.shop_note: Cream cheese: D'lecta, Flanders or Philadelphia on Blinkit/Zepto/Amazon. Savoiardi (optional): Amazon.

recipes.title: Nolen Gur Gelato
recipes.subtitle: Bengal's winter jaggery, frozen silky
recipes.intro: Every winter, Kolkata's sweet shops switch to nolen gur, the smoky, caramel-scented jaggery made from date palm sap. In a milky gelato it tastes like frozen nolen gurer sandesh. Make several pints while the season lasts.

ingredients.note: Amul Spray or any whole milk powder

ingredients.item: nolen gur (liquid jhola or grated patali)

steps.text: In a heavy pan, whisk cornflour, milk powder and salt with 60 ml of the cold milk until smooth.
Add the remaining milk and cream. Cook on medium-low, whisking, 5–6 minutes until it coats a spoon like thin custard.
Cool 10–15 minutes until warm, not hot. Stir in the nolen gur until dissolved, press on cling film and cool fully.
Blend the cooled base in the Blast 30 seconds. Taste; add 1 tsp more gur if needed. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO.
Drizzle with liquid nolen gur, or crumble a Joynagar moa on top.

tips: Never add gur to very hot milk; its natural acidity can split it. Waiting until the base is just warm keeps it smooth.
Nolen gur is in season November to February. Otherwise buy jars or tubes online; real ones smell smoky-sweet, not like molasses.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO before serving.
swaps: Regular jaggery: use 80 g dark, soft jaggery plus 10 g sugar. Tasty, without nolen gur's smoky perfume.
Mix-in: after spinning, add 2 crumbled Joynagar moa or 2 tbsp toasted chopped cashews to a well and run MIX-IN.
Protein: cut milk to 250 ml; blast 1 scoop unflavoured whey into the fully cooled base. Rest foam; expect one RE-SPIN. Adds 24 g protein.

egg_option.title: Custard-style with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks with the milk powder and salt, slowly pour in the steaming milk and cream, return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 250 ml milk. Add gur once warm.

recipes.shop_note: Nolen gur jars and tubes: Amazon, BigBasket or Bengali sweet shops in winter. Regular jaggery: any kirana.

recipes.title: Gianduja Gelato
recipes.subtitle: Turin's chocolate and hazelnut classic
recipes.intro: Gianduja was born in 19th-century Turin, when cocoa was scarce and chocolatiers stretched it with local hazelnuts. Deeper and nuttier than plain chocolate, it tastes like the best spoonful of Nutella, frozen dense.

steps.text: In a heavy pan, whisk sugar, cornflour, cocoa and salt with 60 ml of the cold milk into a smooth paste.
Add the remaining milk and cream. Cook on medium-low, whisking, 5–6 minutes until thickened. Off heat, whisk in chocolate and Nutella until glossy.
Press cling film onto the surface and cool fully to room temperature.
Blend the cooled base in the Blast 30–45 seconds until completely smooth. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, add the hazelnuts and run MIX-IN.
Serve with extra hazelnuts or a warm spoonful of Nutella.

tips: The cooled base should pour like thick chocolate custard. If it sets too firm, loosen it with 1 tbsp milk in the Blast.
Taste hazelnuts before using; old stock turns rancid quickly. Buy small packs and keep them in the fridge.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO before serving.
swaps: Pure hazelnut: skip the Nutella; soak 50 g roasted hazelnuts in hot water 30 minutes, drain and blend with the base, plus 15 g sugar.
Protein: cut milk to 250 ml; blast 1 scoop chocolate whey into the cooled base. Rest foam; expect one RE-SPIN. Adds 24 g protein.
Swap the hazelnuts for roasted almonds or cashews if easier to find.

egg_option.title: Custard-style with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks with the sugar, cocoa and salt; slowly pour in the steaming milk and cream, return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 250 ml milk. Then add chocolate and Nutella.

recipes.shop_note: Hazelnuts: Happilo or Urban Platter on Amazon/BigBasket. Nutella: Blinkit/Zepto.

recipes.title: Dulce de Leche Gelato
recipes.subtitle: Milkmaid, slowly caramelised, safely
recipes.intro: Cook Milkmaid slowly in an open bowl and it turns into dulce de leche, Argentina's thick, toffee-brown caramel. It flavours this milky gelato, then goes in again as a sticky ribbon.

ingredients.item: Nestlé Milkmaid, for the dulce de leche

mixins.item: chilled dulce de leche, from the batch

steps.text: Pour the Milkmaid into a steel bowl; cover with foil. Never heat the sealed tin. Stand it on a trivet in a pressure cooker, water halfway up.
High heat to the first whistle, then low 40 minutes; let pressure release naturally. Whisk the amber caramel smooth and cool.
Whisk cornflour and salt into 60 ml cold milk, add the remaining milk and cream, and cook, whisking, 5 minutes until it coats a spoon.
Off heat, whisk in 150 g dulce de leche. Press on cling film and cool fully to room temperature.
Blend the cooled base in the Blast 30 seconds. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Run GELATO.
Make a 4 cm well to the bottom, spoon in 40 g chilled dulce de leche and run MIX-IN for ribbons. Serve at once.

tips: No cooker? Stir Milkmaid in a heavy non-stick pan on the lowest flame 25–35 minutes, or bake covered in a water bath, 220 °C, 60–75 minutes.
Never boil the unopened tin, a popular shortcut: if the water runs low, the tin can burst violently. Extra dulce keeps a week, refrigerated.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and RE-SPIN on GELATO before serving.
swaps: Salted caramel crunch: add 2 crushed Lotus Biscoff biscuits to the well with the ribbon.
Protein: cut milk to 230 ml; blast 1 scoop vanilla or caramel whey into the cooled base. Rest foam; expect one RE-SPIN. Adds 24 g protein.
Short on time: use 190 g store-bought dulce de leche or thick caramel spread.

egg_option.title: Custard-style with 2 yolks
egg_option.text: Whisk 2 yolks with the salt, slowly pour in the steaming milk and cream, return to low heat and stir to 80–82 °C. Skip cornflour; use 230 ml milk. Then whisk in the dulce de leche.

recipes.shop_note: Milkmaid: any grocery app or kirana. Ready dulce de leche (optional): Amazon.

recipes.title: Kala Khatta Gola Sorbet
recipes.subtitle: The Juhu beach gola, now scoopable
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, re-spin once with 1 tbsp water
recipes.intro: Every Indian summer has a gola stall with a bottle of inky kala khatta, a squeeze of nimbu and a shake of kala namak. This sorbet keeps that sweet-sour-salty hit, minus the ice shards.

steps.text: Blend syrup, water, lime juice, kala namak, chaat masala and pepper in the Ninja Blast 30 seconds until the salt dissolves.
Taste: it should be a little sweeter and saltier than a drink, since freezing dulls flavour. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump with a spoon and run SORBET. If powdery, add 1 tbsp water and RE-SPIN.
Scoop into chilled bowls, add a few drops of lime and dust with chaat masala, gola-style.

tips: Kala khatta syrups are about 50–60% sugar, which keeps this scoopable. Squashes are thinner and freeze icier, so check the label says syrup.
For the full gola moment, serve in paper cups with wooden spoons and extra lime at the table.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin on SORBET before serving.
swaps: Fresh jamun (June–July): pulp 250 g ripe jamun off the seeds; blend with 80 g sugar, 120 ml water, the lime and spices; strain.
Lower sugar: 120 ml syrup, 270 ml water. Sugar drops from about 24% to 18%, so it freezes harder and icier; expect one or two re-spins.
Soda float: drop a scoop into chilled masala soda or plain soda.
recipes.shop_note: Kala khatta syrup: Mala's on Amazon, Blinkit or BigBasket. Kala namak, chaat masala: MDH or Everest, any kirana.

recipes.title: Aam Panna Sorbet
recipes.subtitle: Raw mango, roasted jeera, loo-proof
recipes.respin: Rarely needed; if crumbly, re-spin once with 1 tbsp water
recipes.intro: Nani swore by aam panna against the May loo, and she was right. Cooked raw mango, roasted jeera, kala namak and mint make a pale green sorbet that is sharp, salty and cooling at once.

ingredients.note: firm and sour; yields ~180 g pulp
or half grated jaggery, for darker panna

steps.text: Pressure cook the whole mangoes with 1 cup water for 3 whistles, or boil 15 minutes, until the skins split and the flesh is soft.
When cool enough to handle, peel and scrape all the pulp off the skins and seeds. You should have about 180 g.
Stir the sugar into the warm pulp until dissolved, warming it a minute on low if grains remain.
Cool to room temperature, at least 30 minutes. Never put a warm base in the sealed Blast.
Blend the pulp, water, jeera, kala namak, mint and salt in the Ninja Blast 45 seconds. Pour into the pint under MAX FILL.
Lid on; freeze level for 24 h.
Flatten any hump and run SORBET. Only if powdery, add 1 tbsp water and RE-SPIN.
Serve with a pinch of roasted jeera and a torn mint leaf.

tips: Raw mangoes vary in sourness. The blended base should taste slightly too sweet and salty as a drink; freezing mutes both.
Don't overblend the mint or the base turns murky brown-green; a few visible flecks look best.
Leftovers: flatten the top, refreeze, and re-spin before serving.
swaps: Shortcut: blend 200 ml ready aam panna concentrate (Mapro) with 200 ml water and the spices; skip the cooking.
